title: Once Upon a Time in Gielinor: Finale
start: Talk to Closure in his office to find out more. It can be accessed via Death's realm.
prereq_quests: Once Upon a Time in Gielinor: Fortunes

rewards.t: Golden partyhat shard (only during the Golden Partyhat Hunt event)

steps.t: Talk to Closure. [Chat: Accept]
Walk into the southern waiting lobby and complete the flashbacks for Kami, Meg, and Philipe.
Talk to Kami. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Relomia. [Chat: 3 Assign a task to Fraji. › 4 Fend off the Tiger's Claw!]
Assign ally to the Big door (large green door). [Chat: 1 Kami.]
Assign ally to any of the Intricate locks (blue circular matrix at the center). [Chat: 2 Honovi.]
Assign ally to the Strange symbols (the large golden gong to the east). [Chat: 3 Sojobo.]
p: Kami and other guardians of Kami-shima at the Sanctuary of the Four Winds.

steps.t: Talk to Relomia [Chat: 4 Play back memory.]
Talk to Kami after the cutscene.
Talk to Meg. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Relomia. [Chat: 3 Assign a task to the Raptor. › 4 Delay Sutcliffe's return!]
Assign ally to the front door of the castle. [Chat: 1 Meg.]
Assign ally to the Black Knight patrol (he stands west of the start of the bridge). [Chat: 2 Eva Cashien.]
p: Meg and the Grey Knights at the Black Knights' Fortress.

steps.t: Assign ally to the Roof access (the step-ladder east of the start of the bridge). [Chat: 3 Captain Higgs.]
Talk to Relomia. [Chat: 4 Play back memory.]
Talk to Meg after the cutscene.
Talk to Philipe Carnillean. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Relomia. [Chat: 3 Assign a task to Oreb. › 4 Taunt the Bright Inquisitor!]
Assign ally to the World Gate controls. [Chat: 1 Philipe.]
p: Philipe, Zilyana, Nymora and Oreb face the Teragardian Bright Inquisitor at the World Gate.

steps.t: Assign ally to the Defender position. [Chat: 2 Commander Zilyana.]
Assign ally to the Bright Inquisitor. [Chat: 3 Nymora.]
Talk to Relomia. [Chat: 4 Play back memory.]
Talk to Philipe after the cutscene.
Talk to Closure twice.
